            setRange(f, t, l, m, val, node.left);
            setRange(f, t, m + 1, r, val, node.right);
            node.pushUp();
        }

        public void pushUp() {
            this.min = Math.min(left.min, right.min);
        }

        public void setValue(int v) {
            this.min = v;
            this.lazyVal = v;
            this.lazyFlag = true;
        }

        public void pushDown() {
            if (lazyFlag) {
                left.setValue(lazyVal);
                right.setValue(lazyVal);
                lazyFlag = false;
            }
        }
    }
}
